//: Set ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development to pick this up. It overrides only the facilitator: point FacilitatorUrl at one you run yourself (a local reference facilitator, or anything else speaking the same wire protocol) instead of the public https://x402.org/facilitator in appsettings.json. For a fully offline run with no facilitator process at all, use UseFakeFacilitator instead (see samples/README.md) — that switch is independent of this file and of the environment.
